match: a torus / donut / bagel / ring shape — labels like "torus", "donut", "3d ring", or a donut sketch (circle with a hole)
params: {"major_r": 0.5-1.6, "minor_r": 0.1-1.0; "flat": true|false — start flattened/unfolded; "slice": true|false — open the slicing plane; "tilt": 0-180, "offset": -1.4..1.4, "spin": 0-360, "cut": "full"|"above"|"below"} — all optional
